stable.notes: A large session now opens with its full history rather than a sliver. The previous release fixed the outright refusal but read only the newest 8 MB, which on a 278 MB transcript surfaced fifteen turns where the session view can hold a hundred and twenty. The window is now sized by measurement: 64 MB fills the view's turn budget on that same transcript in about a second, and reading further buys nothing. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
